subject: CEO review: one-off free credits for platform integrator

Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request from DistroHQ: additional free credits + 45-day POC extension

Hi team,

Quick summary of the call with Samir (DistroHQ): they're running a platform integration POC and hit a technical milestone; they asked for a one-off extension of the POC + additional complimentary credits beyond our PLG limits to finish performance validation. Current limits would leave them unable to complete the last integration scenario.

They requested:
- 45 day extension to the sandbox (current remaining ~7 days)
- Additional 300k token credits (one-off, not a change to pricing)

Attachments: Delta_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (attachment), usage_snapshot.csv (attachment)

Why it matters:
- DistroHQ is a target partner for our platform integrator program; their integration could drive a multi-year committed contract and channel referrals.
- Sales estimates ~ $1.2M ARR if we secure platform embed + marketplace listing.

Asking for an executive sign-off to grant the extension + credits or an alternative limited uplift (e.g., 30 days + 150k credits) we can offer quickly. We're short on time — they asked for an answer by EOD PST.

Thanks,
Alex

> Quick summary of the call with Samir (DistroHQ): ...

Thanks for the context, Alex — adding a little color from our side.

- DistroHQ is already running two internal pilots (infra + billing) in parallel; their infra team is the gating factor for embed. If they finish the integration test suite they will move to procurement for a committed plan.
- Legal flagged that DistroHQ will require a short addendum if we extend the sandbox beyond the standard PLG window; they also asked for token usage visibility.

Recommended ask to execs: approve a one-off package: 30 days + 200k credits, with a short addendum (standard one-way SLA/usage terms) and a HubSpot note. If execs prefer to make a stronger play, authorize the 45/300k but attach a success milestone (marketplace listing commitment within 90 days).

I'm looping Jordan for deal desk and Aditya for CRO-level sign-off given the strategic partner angle.

2) Can Sales commit to an internal milestone (marketplace listing conversation scheduled within 60 days) as part of the approval?

If Legal and Sales both confirm, I'm inclined to approve 30 days + 200k tokens as a one-off, recorded in HubSpot and with a requirement that the customer attends a marketplace onboarding session.
